The Supreme Court has allowed green firecrackers in Delhi-NCR on November 7 and 8, but environmental activists have raised concerns over poor enforcement and rising pollution. While traders say the short notice has left them with little time to arrange stocks, Delhi Police have announced restrictions on the sale and use of firecrackers. A firecracker fair in Siliguri is also selling only NEDFI-certified green crackers, with safety measures in place.
Thank you for watching our video!
